description: A tall narrow tower with a crenellated top and a small arched window stands on the right. A drawbridge plank angles down to the left from the tower base, held by a diagonal chain, above short water waves.
A domed hard hat with a raised central ridge and a wide flat brim sits on a stand: a single vertical post rising from a horizontal foot beneath the brim.
A domed hard hat with a raised central ridge and a wide flat brim sits on a stand: a single vertical post rising from a horizontal foot beneath the brim.
A tall rounded face mask faces forward with two circular eye lenses side by side. A short cylindrical filter canister with an elliptical front projects from the bottom of the mask.
A six-pointed star formed by two overlapping triangles has a small ball at each tip. A circle sits at the centre of the star, inside the hexagonal overlap.
A square castle tower has a crenellated top wider than its body. An arched doorway rises from the base, with a keyhole shape centred inside the arch.
A face mask spans the width with a curved upper edge and a deeper curved lower edge. Ear loops curve outward at both sides, and two horizontal pleat lines cross the centre panel.
A shield with a peaked top and a pointed base has a narrow inset border following its outline. A vertical line runs from the peak to the point, dividing the inner panel into two halves.
A shield with a peaked top, straight upper sides and a pointed base holds a second outline set closely inside it, leaving a thin even band between the two.
A sleeveless vest seen from the front has a scooped neckline between two shoulder straps and a flat hem. Small rectangular side fastener tabs sit on both lower sides.
A single straight horizontal wire runs across the width, with three evenly spaced barbs: each a pair of short crossing strokes that twist over the wire in an X.

Two striding figures face left. The front figure wears a helmet with a visor and holds a tall upright shield at its left edge; the rear figure leans forward with both arms extended, pushing against its back.
Two tall upright riot shields stand side by side, each a slightly bowed rectangle with a curved top edge. A horizontal viewing window with a short slot sits near the top of each.
A plain shield outline with a gently arched top, straight upper sides and curved lower sides that meet in a rounded point, with an empty interior.
A plain shield outline with a gently arched top, straight upper sides and curved lower sides that meet in a rounded point, with an empty interior.
A large shield with a peaked top and pointed base contains a smaller matching shield at its centre. A wide, even band of space separates the inner shield from the outer outline.
A handheld scanning wand lies on a diagonal from lower left to upper right: a narrow handle joins a longer, wider rounded head. Two pairs of curved signal arcs sit on opposite sides of the head.
A flat, wide housing tapers into a squat camera body beneath it. An L-shaped bracket drops from the body and turns left to end in a small rectangular wall foot.
A wide flat ceiling plate sits above a half-circle dome. An arched lens housing rises inside the dome, with a circular lens and a centre dot.
A rounded rectangular camera body tilts on a diagonal, with a short separate lens stroke along its left end. A post drops from its underside and bends right into a flat horizontal base.
A long horizontal box camera has an angled lens hood jutting from its lower left end. A short neck with a small ring joins an arm running right to an upright rounded wall plate.
A rounded rectangular camera body tilts on a diagonal, with a short separate lens stroke along its right end. A post drops from its underside and bends left into a flat horizontal base.
A long horizontal box camera has an angled lens hood jutting from its lower right end. A short neck with a small ring joins an arm running left to an upright rounded wall plate.
A teardrop map pin with a circular hole points down into the centre of a wide flat ellipse. A short open curve around the pin tip forms an inner ring on the ground.
A whistle seen from the side has a round chamber with a circular hole and a flat rectangular mouthpiece extending to the upper right. A small half-round loop projects from the back of the chamber.
A whistle seen from the side has a round chamber with a circular hole and a flat rectangular mouthpiece extending straight out to the upper right.
A domed hard hat with a raised central ridge and a flat brim sits directly on top of a gear. The gear’s teeth run around the lower half, and a rounded cutout beneath the brim forms its centre.
